designSummary: Descriptive rates per 1,000 doses by episode, with the pre-episode rate for the original product as a baseline.
sampleSize: All doses and reports in the defined periods are included, so there is no sampling. With perhaps 2,000 to 10,000 doses per episode and error rates of a few per 1,000, each rate will have a wide interval; the analysis is descriptive and compares episodes cautiously.
primaryAnalysis: Rate per 1,000 doses with exact Poisson 95 percent confidence intervals for each episode and its baseline period; rate ratio of episode to baseline per product.
secondaryAnalysis: Error type and stage by episode; proportion reaching the patient.
missingData: Incident reports without a product name are reviewed by date and ward; unresolvable reports are counted and reported.
multiplicity: Three episodes described; no formal testing between them.
software: R for rates and exact intervals.
overfittingGuards: No modelling beyond rates and rate ratios
summary: Descriptive rates with exact intervals and a pre-episode baseline.
